extra.final_summary: The data had two issues affecting the analysis: (1) two rows with negative flipper_length_mm values (-185, -212) were outside the allowed range [170, 235] and were excluded; (2) two rows with extremely high body_mass_g values (4,450,000 and 5,700,000 grams) exceeded the maximum allowed 6,500 grams and were excluded. After these exclusions, the average body mass for each species was calculated on 63 valid rows. The results are: Adelie: 3,687.5 grams, Chinstrap: 3,726.7 grams, Gentoo: 5,253.6 grams.
